text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce battle, Narita Taishin 
brilliantly conquered the Nippon Derby, 
but the exhaustion was severe, causing her 
to collapse after the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Winning Ticket and Biwa 
Hayahide came to visit, relieved to see 
that she was alright—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Declaring that she will win the next 
stage—the final leg of the Triple Crown 
route, the "Kikuka Sho"—she walks away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the resolute backs of those two, 
Narita Taishin found them dazzlingly 
bright.
